title: 第23章 钱从何处来第24章 校园学长
content_zh:
;;
单凭云阳的要求院方肯定是不会给云阳看监控录像的。
所以云阳只能行使一下刚加入官方的超能者的“特权”了。
作为灵能局作战科的人，紧急调动各种监控的权利还是有的。
给黎重打了个电话，五分钟之后，医院方面就派人带云阳去查监控去了。
神属性达到600+的云阳直接开八倍速观看监控，很快，云阳就发现了包裹出现的时间。
是今天早晨六点。
而出现的方式也很怪异，一个出去水房打水的妇人路过自己的病房门口的一瞬间，那纸箱就突兀的出现在病房门口了。
可以说是完美的挡住了摄像头的视野。
“这个妇人是几号病房的？”云阳问道。
旁边陪同的护士连忙看了眼手里的病例单，回答道：“301号，她们家有一老人突发心梗，她是作为陪护人员待在医院里。”
云阳接过护士手里的病例单，仔细看了看，随后说道：“能不能带我去见见她？”
“好的，请随我来。”
不出所料的，这个妇人果然……
只是个普通的中年妇女，并没有任何奇怪之处。
emmm……
烦恼了两个小时，想不明白的云阳决定不再去想这件事了。
没有意义。
难道这个垃圾病毒手游有风险，难道自己就不依靠它变强了么？
关于这个垃圾病毒手游背后是否真的有什么存在这件事，真的重要吗？

不重要。
因为以现在自己的能力又无法查明，既然如此，多想只会让自己无端忧虑罢了。
还不如提高实力，到时候即便这个垃圾病毒手游背后真的有什么想对自己不利的存在，自己也能一拳打爆它的狗头！
无论什么算计都是虚假的，只有实力才是实打实的！
嗯？云阳突然发现，自己的思维怎么开始往“莽夫”方面靠近的？
难道是因为走上了体修之路的原因？
“唉~”
云阳不禁抬头四十五度角抬头望天，和那位归元道人一样，眼角划过一滴泪珠。
曾经风度翩翩，潇洒飘逸的自己已经逐渐远去了啊。
或许这就是所谓的成长吧……
两天后。
云阳终于还是出院了。
如果可以的话，云阳其实还想多躺几天的。
他原本都准备在游戏里进阶筑基了。
但在游戏里选择准备筑基的时候，苏沐雪拦住了他，并对他说三个月后玄天门外门将要进行三年一度的外门大比，如果能在外门大比上拿到成绩，不仅能获得丹药和法宝等奖励，而且还会引起内门诸峰长老的注意，被那些长老们相中，以后进入内门也更容易找到师承。
content_en:
;;
Based on Yunyang's request alone, the hospital would definitely not show Yunyang the surveillance video.
Therefore, Yunyang could only exercise the "privilege" of a superpower who had just joined the officialdom.
As a member of the Operations Section of the Psionics Bureau, you still have the right to urgently mobilize all kinds of surveillance.
He called Li Zhong, and five minutes later, the hospital sent someone to take Yunyang to check the surveillance system.
Yunyang, who had a divine attribute of 600+, directly turned on the monitor at eight times speed. Soon, Yunyang discovered the time when the package appeared.
It's six o'clock this morning.
The way it appeared was also very strange. The moment a woman who went out to fetch water from the water room passed by the door of her ward, the cardboard box suddenly appeared at the door of the ward.
It can be said that it perfectly blocks the camera's field of view.
"What ward number is this woman from?" Yunyang asked.
The accompanying nurse quickly looked at the case sheet in her hand and replied: "On the 301st, an elderly person in their family suffered a heart attack. She is staying in the hospital as a companion."
Yunyang took the case sheet from the nurse's hand, looked at it carefully, and then said, "Can you take me to see her?"
"Okay, please come with me."
As expected, this woman is indeed...
She is just an ordinary middle-aged woman, nothing strange about her.
emmm…
Yunyang, who had been troubled for two hours and couldn't figure it out, decided not to think about it anymore.
Makes no sense.
Is this junk virus mobile game risky? Don’t you rely on it to become stronger?
Does it really matter whether there is something behind this junk virus mobile game?
unimportant.
Because I can't find out with my current ability. In this case, thinking too much will only make me worry for no reason.
It's better to improve your strength. Even if there is someone behind this junk virus mobile game who really wants to harm you, you can still blow its head off with one punch!
No matter what calculations are made, they are false, only strength is real!
Um? Yunyang suddenly realized how his thinking began to move closer to the "reckless man" side?
Is it because I have embarked on the path of physical cultivation?
"Alas~"
Yunyang couldn't help but look up at the sky at a forty-five-degree angle. Just like the Taoist Guiyuan, a teardrop flashed across the corner of his eye.
The once graceful and elegant self has gradually faded away.
Maybe this is what is called growth...
Two days later.
Yunyang was finally discharged from the hospital.
If possible, Yunyang would actually like to stay in bed for a few more days.
He was originally planning to advance to foundation building in the game.
But when he chose to prepare for foundation building in the game, Su Muxue stopped him and told him that in three months the Xuantian Sect's outer sect would hold a triennial outer sect competition. If he could get the results in the outer sect competition, he would not only get rewards such as elixirs and magic weapons, but also attract the attention of the elders of the inner sect. If he is favored by those elders, it would be easier to find a mentor if he enters the inner sect in the future.
